scope: Read-only CPU descriptive check of channel content, hover label/time association, normal early/late channel means and saved source-val model scores. No model inference/training, raw-log audit, feature deletion or final-test/Real.
population: Time/label inventory uses current included source train/val ledgers. Physical-channel profiles reuse exactly36 already-fixed hover cases from kinematic_residual_discrimination_v1. No new case selection by residuals, predictions or channel drift.
features: All26 current normalized input channel window means and within-window std, computed with original canonical_window including raw acceleration norm recomputation and subtracting each window's baro start. All original admitted windows, not the new4-residual eligibility subset. Do not reinterpret raw case baro absolute values as model input.
stages: Window endpoint position in original retained crop quarters. Time bins are seconds since crop start, not absolute boot/UTC time or authenticated flight phase. Do not use elapsed time or directory labels as model inputs.
comparisons: Case-paired normal early25% vs late25% channel-mean changes in units of frozen source-train std. Report all26, no p-value or group-wise independence claim. Existing saved long-budget source-val probabilities for the same normal windows provide descriptive co-variation, never causal feature attribution.
predictions: Use only existing source-val predictions from restored100-epoch budget two arms. Verify original IDs and labels against source val ledger. No old short-budget train predictions or test/Real scores.
interpretation: pos_xyz absent; baro is window-relative, not accumulated absolute altitude. Control integrator states/time not explicit inputs. Other absolute-normalized response channels can encode flight background. Time/label correlation and passive drift do not prove the classifier uses a particular shortcut. No claim all fault classes/modes have identical timing.
stop: Do not automatically remove slow channels, per-window center every feature, fit new normalization, train a time classifier or perform weight/feature ablation. Current scope is documenting evidence, not a fix.
